item.text: I found the domain resource has a plotted `Label` column separate from longer annotations. I’m updating the selected-label TSVs to carry the plotted PFAM label and readable description, which makes the final report and exported tables unambiguous.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
outdir <- 'outputs'
genes <- c('TP53','PIK3CA','GATA3','CDH1')
d <- readRDS(system.file('extdata','protein_domains.RDs',package='maftools'))
for (gene in genes) {
  f <- file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, '_single_top_selected_label_table.tsv'))
  top <- read.delim(f, sep='\\t', header=TRUE, quote='', comment.char='', check.names=FALSE)
  pos <- top"'$AA_Position[1]
  gd <- d[toupper(d$HGNC) == toupper(gene), , drop=FALSE]
  hit <- gd[!is.na(pos) & gd$Start <= pos & gd$End >= pos, , drop=FALSE]
  top$inside_pfam_domain <- nrow(hit) > 0
  top$pfam_domain_label <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Label), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_description <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Description), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_accession <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$pfam), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_start <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Start), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_end <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$End), collapse='"';') else ''
  keep <- c('Hugo_Symbol','AA_Position','mutated_samples','total_mutation_events','inside_pfam_domain','pfam_domain_label','pfam_domain_description','pfam_domain_accession','pfam_domain_start','pfam_domain_end','top_recurrent_HGVSp_Short_changes')
  top <- top[, keep]
  write.table(top, f, sep='\\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
}
combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(genes, function(g) read.delim(file.path(outdir, paste0(g, '_single_top_selected_label_table.tsv')), sep='\\t', header=TRUE, quote='', comment.char='', check.names=FALSE)))
write.table(combined, file.path(outdir, 'all_genes_single_top_label_positions.tsv'), sep='\\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
cat(capture.output(print(combined)), sep='\\n')
RS"

  f <- file.path(outdir, paste0(gene, '_single_top_selected_label_table.tsv'))
  top <- read.delim(f, sep='\\t', header=TRUE, quote='', comment.char='', check.names=FALSE)
  pos <- top"'$AA_Position[1]
  gd <- d[toupper(d$HGNC) == toupper(gene), , drop=FALSE]
  hit <- gd[!is.na(pos) & gd$Start <= pos & gd$End >= pos, , drop=FALSE]
  top$inside_pfam_domain <- nrow(hit) > 0
  top$pfam_domain_label <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Label), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_description <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Description), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_accession <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$pfam), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_start <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$Start), collapse='"';') else ''
  top"'$pfam_domain_end <- if (nrow(hit) > 0) paste(unique(hit$End), collapse='"';') else ''
  keep <- c('Hugo_Symbol','AA_Position','mutated_samples','total_mutation_events','inside_pfam_domain','pfam_domain_label','pfam_domain_description','pfam_domain_accession','pfam_domain_start','pfam_domain_end','top_recurrent_HGVSp_Short_changes')
  top <- top[, keep]
  write.table(top, f, sep='\\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
}
combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(genes, function(g) read.delim(file.path(outdir, paste0(g, '_single_top_selected_label_table.tsv')), sep='\\t', header=TRUE, quote='', comment.char='', check.names=FALSE)))
write.table(combined, file.path(outdir, 'all_genes_single_top_label_positions.tsv'), sep='\\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='')
cat(capture.output(print(combined)), sep='\\n')
